meta.about: Approximate thread colors keyed by brand, then by code in upper case with punctuation removed. Screens and dye lots vary.

methods.photo: calculated from a swatch photo; the photo itself is not stored
methods.name: estimated from the color name, or null when the name gives no color

meta.lookupNotes: Retry without leading zeros if a code misses. Kreinik codes may carry a size prefix such as 12/001, so use the part after the slash. Milan 1xxx and 2xxx codes are the same colors in different package types and yardages, so both carry the same color.

sources.Kreinik: calculated from #12 Braid photos at kreinik.com
sources.Rainbow Gallery lines: code and color names from rainbowgallery.com
sources.Planet Earth lines, Bella Lusso, Neon Ra: calculated from retailer photos at theflyingneedles.com
